protocol.container: v5 flat blocks for ALL methods; fields same as v4; defaults unchanged
protocol.ordering: One full warmup/config, then shuffled condition/round jobs; encode followed by fresh-process restore. All range jobs shuffled separately.
protocol.transforms: Explicit 4-byte grid, per-block reset, literal tail; entire source file including headers/padding
protocol.selection: Ordinary codec first, then selected transform+same codec; use only if payload gain exceeds local label cost. Full metadata cost reported; policy may still lose overall.
protocol.integrity: Unchanged bounded decompression, manifest/block/file SHA and external bytewise restore/range truth; deterministic archives each round.
protocol.persistence: Temporary file, flush/fsync, atomic replace and full archive digest, identical across methods.
protocol.ranges: Same original byte requests per round across every configuration/mode. 64KiB-grid cross_chunk windows may not cross a 1MiB block.
protocol.cache: Full archive pre-read; warm OS cache; no decoded-block cache; fresh process per phase/range trial.
protocol.cost: Entire RKV archive including C-Blosc frames; separate full installed Blosc distribution+adapter source charge once, with optional NumPy if imported. Shared Python/Zstd/core incomplete, not full deployment size.
protocol.rss: Fresh phase processes; range includes truth and metadata ledger, not production RSS
protocol.professional: python-blosc 1.11.4 bytes API, C-Blosc, Zstd, clevel=3, typesize=word_bytes, blocksize=65536, threads=1, releasegil=False; no/shuffle/bitshuffle controls. Not Blosc2, not Blosc NDArray sub-block reads.
protocol.startup: No Blosc preloading in phase workers. First import/setup charged in full encode and first actual-Blosc-frame decode. Range warmups include first-load cost; formal warm ranges do not.
protocol.interpretation: C-Blosc clevel3 and its embedded Zstd version/block splitting differ from direct Zstd3; only its same-profile filter ablations isolate filter choices.

limits: single host, warm OS cache; five rounds are descriptive, not significance evidence
three public astronomy examples (two float32, one small float64), one previous int16 ECG record, one synthetic noise control
astronomy examples share a hosting project; not three independent scientific domains
whole FITS byte grids, not semantic channel/row decomposition; special-value proportions disclosed
Blosc1 Zstd profiles only, not all scientific compressors, NDArray operations or Blosc2
ordinary source/codec allocation incomplete; full standalone and already-installed scenarios separate
no inference, cross-machine/cold-cache, Rust numeric kernel or CAS+numeric integration result
